description: When a typhoon is forecast, many rice farmers in Japan harvest early, even before the grain is fully ripe, because there is no clear rule for when it is safe to wait. We built that rule from NASA data (GPM IMERG rain, NASA POWER wind and temperature), checked against official damage records. On 23 past typhoons, it said "safe to wait" in 10 of 16 no-damage cases and missed 1 of 7. It even runs on a Raspberry Pi Pico. Decision support, not a replacement for farmer judgment.
